# AION 2 Wiki

> Fan-made AION 2 reference and guide site covering classes, long-form guides, and topic explainers in English, German, Korean, and Japanese. This independent wiki is not affiliated with NCSOFT.

Canonical URL: https://aion2.world/
Default language: English (en)
Available languages: en, de, ko, ja
Machine-readable sitemap: https://aion2.world/sitemap.xml

## Main pages

- [Home](https://aion2.world/): Overview of AION 2, featured classes, and key guide entry points.
- [Classes](https://aion2.world/classes/): All AION 2 classes with roles, weapons, and short summaries.
- [Guides](https://aion2.world/guide/): Long-form beginner, release-date, and tier-list guides.
- [Topics](https://aion2.world/topics/): Keyword-based topic hubs for release, access, gameplay, platforms, and community questions.
- [About](https://aion2.world/about/): Site purpose, editorial approach, and contact overview.
- [Contact](https://aion2.world/contact/): Contact information and enquiry categories.

## Class guides

- [Templar](https://aion2.world/classes/templar/): Main tank class guide.
- [Gladiator](https://aion2.world/classes/gladiator/): Frontline bruiser class guide.
- [Assassin](https://aion2.world/classes/assassin/): Melee burst DPS class guide.
- [Ranger](https://aion2.world/classes/ranger/): Ranged kiting DPS class guide.
- [Sorcerer](https://aion2.world/classes/sorcerer/): Ranged burst caster class guide.
- [Spiritmaster](https://aion2.world/classes/spiritmaster/): Pet and summoning DPS class guide.
- [Cleric](https://aion2.world/classes/cleric/): Main healer class guide.
- [Chanter](https://aion2.world/classes/chanter/): Hybrid support and DPS class guide.

## Long-form guides

- [Beginner guide](https://aion2.world/guide/beginner-guide/): First-hours orientation, class choice, flight basics, and early progression.
- [Release date guide](https://aion2.world/guide/release-date/): Release and availability information.
- [Tier list](https://aion2.world/guide/tier-list/): Class comparisons for PvE and PvP contexts.
